# Build dependencies

Kept here so CI doesn't depend on third-party repositories.

- `iPhoneOS26.5.sdk.tar.xz` - iOS 26.5 SDK for Theos (from Tonwalter888/iOS-SDKs). The workflows extract it into `$THEOS/sdks`.
- `alderis.deb` - Alderis color picker (from Tonwalter888.github.io), needed by YouSlider in IPA builds.
